listings.title: Cannondale Slice 54 (M), carbon, Mavic Cosmic + Fulcrum spare wheels
listings.verdict: Seller came down from $1,250 to $1,150. Likely 10-speed Force, not the 11 in the ad; counter at $1,000 suggested.
notes: Standard calipers, alloy brake track, 130 mm QR: fits the ThinkRider
Chips on the chainstay and head tube: coin-tap at viewing

listings.title: Cervélo P1 54, alloy, carbon fork
listings.verdict: Best value found so far: fits, strong resale, comes with near-new GP5000s and a split-nose saddle. Groupset and year unknown.

listings.title: Cervélo P2 SL 2008, T2 bars, R500 wheels
listings.verdict: Under 1,000 km, listed 27 weeks and already dropped from $1,400. Size not stated.

listings.title: Planet X Stealth Pro Carbon, Medium
listings.verdict: Carbon frame, deep wheels (material unknown), worn cockpit. Weak resale brand; only fair near $1,000.

listings.title: Specialized Transition 53.4 (M), SRAM
listings.verdict: Fits. Year and brake type unknown; early Transitions are fine, later ones use proprietary brakes.

listings.title: Cervélo P2 "52"
listings.verdict: Seller is 5'4" and raced Mont-Tremblant 70.3. 52 is borderline for 5'9"; needs the real frame size.

listings.title: Trek Speed Concept L/54
listings.verdict: About 6 h away, past the 3 h limit, and 1st-gen proprietary brakes and stem.

runs.summary: Seeded from the 24 Sep sweeps: 6 tracked, Slice in negotiation.
